intro.h2: Know the number before the hammer swings
paragraphs: Kitchen remodeling in Denton, TX usually goes wrong in the gap between a quick bid and the real bill. Wreedone closes that gap up front. On the first visit the team listens, looks at the space and gives you a budget range built from real numbers on its last four similar projects.

From there you walk through the design in photoreal 3D, choose every finish, and sign a pre-construction agreement with an itemized price. If you change something later, you see the cost before work goes ahead. Most Wreedone kitchens run $60,000 to $150,000 or more, depending on size, layout changes and finishes.

about.h2: Wil Reed and the Wreedone team
about.text: Wil Reed founded Wreedone in Denton in 2017 on a simple belief: a home renovation should not be a nightmare. After seeing firsthand how most contractors operate, he set out to do it differently, with a refined process, thorough communication and work the team is proud to sign. More than 150 North Texas homes later, he is the standard every project is held to. Spencer Stewart builds your estimate and 3D renderings, project managers Justin Hamel and Chase Kubiak run the build, and Keith Gumera looks after you from first call to final walkthrough. Every photo on the site is real Wreedone work.

faq.h2: What Denton homeowners ask before they remodel

items.q: What does a kitchen remodel cost in Denton?
items.a: Most Wreedone kitchen remodels run $60,000 to $150,000 or more, depending on size, layout changes and finishes. At the first in-home visit you get a budget range built from the team's last four similar projects, then an itemized price in the pre-construction agreement before any work starts.

items.q: Will I see my kitchen or bathroom before it is built?
items.a: Yes. Every project starts as a photoreal 3D design. You walk through the exact layout, cabinets, tile and fixtures, refine them with the team and choose every finish. What you approve on screen is what gets built in your home, so there are no surprises on demo day.

Wreedone gives a full workmanship warranty on every project for five years, in writing. If something is not right, the team makes it right with one call. The coverage transfers to the next owner if you sell, and scheduled check-ins happen at 3, 6 and 11 months.

Wreedone does not lend money itself and earns no fee from financing. If monthly payments suit your family, two independent marketplaces are built into the estimate: HFS, with home improvement loans up to 20 years and no equity required, and Acorn Finance, which compares 30+ lenders. Prequalifying is a soft credit check.

items.q: Can you fix a shower another contractor ruined?
items.a: Yes. Google reviewer Anna C. hired a sub to retile her shower, and the job ended up destroying both shower and tile. It turned into a complete overhaul with new walls and a new pan, and she called Wil's team to do it. She later wrote that the company is truly unlike any other.

final_cta.h2: See your new kitchen in 3D first
final_cta.text: Book a free in-home consult or a 20-minute planning call. The team replies within one business day.
